policy.scope: Antiquities and The Dark red scans only. A candidate must pass its own ten known-pose recovery checks, content replacement, negative controls, independent box checks and warped-raster replay. This is finite-cohort qualification, not a blanket claim that the method handles other scans or materials.
policy.fit: Twenty-four disjoint art-outline profiles fit one six-parameter affine transform. Rules-box profiles never choose the pose. Independent art/rules strips certify consistency; a local rules-box displacement is rejected. Neither renderer pixels nor text/content matching enters the fit.
policy.cohorts: Frozen name-separated calibration/validation membership. Existing scans are reused development references; no claim of fresh validation.
policy.limits: Known-pose corner error <0.30 canonical pixels; content-replacement error <0.10; independent/raster profile residual RMS <=0.40. Fixed bounded affine model, no per-region or projective warp.
policy.adoption: New comparison manifest adds accepted poses without changing any previous accepted pose or historical score. No renderer defaults, live review templates, published version or full-card scores change.
